system.description: • Effect: Once per day, when you use Marked Prey, for the encounter your marked prey has Disadvantage on Hide checks against you, its speed is halved while it moves away from you, and you know where it is while it's within 60ft; a creature that turns invisible stays marked.

activities.name: Apex Predator
activities.text: Once per day, when you use Marked Prey: for the encounter your marked prey has Disadvantage on Hide checks against you, its speed is halved while it moves away from you, and you know where it is while it's within 60ft; a creature that turns invisible stays marked. From 24th level (Peerless Hunter) it has no daily limit.
